integrations.title: Integration Center
integrations.subtitle: Securely connect AIOS to the tools you already use.
integrations.intro: Integrations connect AIOS to external systems. Communications operates your conversations and Content publishes your marketing — both run on the services you connect here. Harmony coordinates everything; you connect once.

discovery.channelsHint: Channels you connect in the Integration Center appear here automatically — Communications uses them with no extra setup.
discovery.publishersHint: Publishing platforms you connect in the Integration Center appear here automatically — Content publishes to them with no extra setup.
